Apple (AAPL) is Hanseatic Management Services Inc.’s Largest Position Posted by Caroline Horne | Mar 20th, 2018 
Hanseatic Management Services Inc. cut its stake in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 50.5% in the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The fund owned 29,220 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 29,813 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up 5.1% of Hanseatic Management Services Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its largest holding. Hanseatic Management Services Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,503,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. 
Several other large investors also recently bought and sold shares of the company. Schnieders Capital Management LLC lifted its position in Apple by 3.6% in the second quarter. Schnieders Capital Management LLC now owns 41,583 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,989,000 after purchasing an additional 1,435 shares during the period. DT Investment Partners LLC lifted its position in Apple by 46.3% in the second quarter. DT Investment Partners LLC now owns 2,684 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $387,000 after purchasing an additional 850 shares during the period. Alpha Cubed Investments LLC lifted its position in Apple by 15.6% in the second quarter. Alpha Cubed Investments LLC now owns 231,712 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $33,371,000 after purchasing an additional 31,227 shares during the period. Eagle Global Advisors LLC lifted its position in Apple by 1.6% in the second quarter. Eagle Global Advisors LLC now owns 210,143 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $30,265,000 after purchasing an additional 3,340 shares during the period. Finally, Probity Advisors Inc. lifted its position in Apple by 1.7% in the second quarter. Probity Advisors Inc. now owns 4,789 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $690,000 after purchasing an additional 80 shares during the period. 61.33% of the stock is owned by institutional investors. A number of brokerages have recently commented on AAPL. Zacks Investment Research downgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Friday, January 19th. Mizuho reiterated a “neutral” rating and set a $175.00 price objective (up previously from $160.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, January 19th. Barclays set a $174.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research report on Thursday, January 18th. Vetr lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $184.49 target price for the company. in a report on Tuesday, February 27th. Finally, Bank of America lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and increased their target price for the company from $180.00 to $220.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 17th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. Apple presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.53. 
In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Company insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock. 
Apple ( AAPL ) traded down $0.06 on Tuesday, reaching $175.24. 19,602,195 shares of the company’s stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 37,462,656. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a 12-month low of $138.62 and a 12-month high of $183.50. The firm has a market cap of $903,275.88, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.01, a PEG ratio of 1.34 and a beta of 1.19. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the previous year, the business earned $3.36 EPS. equities analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
